projection_formula.x: official #658 balanced_time_ratio * measured method equal-file mean(median(candidate total_s reps)/median(incumbent total_s reps)) / same-run-block calibration anchor raw X

projection_formula.pool_share: independently recomputed from captured Pareto base plus one point using the captured official bounds and local-global-improvement-space-log rule

limitations: This verifies public snapshot geometry, source-backed two-axis projections, raw receipt identity, and scoring replay only.
Candidate main and same-binary copy control are kept separate; calibration views do not create independent samples.
Formal gate/proof acceptance, admission, registration attribution, and realized payout are not inferred from this scoring audit.
A mismatch between the latest scorer and analyze-round26's previously configured scorer is reported only; the old script is not modified.
